instruction: Adjust the titles on slides 1, 4, and 5 so their font size is 32 points.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing title font size to 32 points in slides 1, 4, and 5. Evaluator uses custom getter to extract font sizes from title text and custom metric to verify all three slides have 32pt font size (with tolerance of 1pt for minor variations). Slide titles are: Slide 1='Goal Roadmap', Slide 4='Add an Agenda Page', Slide 5='Write your topic or idea'.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Each correctly sized slide contributes 1/3 to the final score (partial credit enabled)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly identifies title shapes using proper placeholder type checking (pptx_getters.py:44-54). It checks shape.is_placeholder and shape.placeholder_format.type in (1, 3) to identify PP_PLACEHOLDER.TITLE and PP_PLACEHOLDER.CENTER_TITLE.

Robust fallback logic implemented (pptx_getters.py:56-74). If no title placeholder found, it checks for is_title attribute, then falls back to topmost text shape based on vertical position. This handles various PowerPoint/Impress layouts correctly.

Font size extraction handles mixed formatting correctly (pptx_getters.py:78-97). It collects all font sizes from all runs, checks consistency, and uses predominant font size when mixed formatting is detected. This ensures accurate measurement even with partial formatting.

Metric function correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' (pptx_metrics.py:15). It directly accesses expected.get('slide_font_sizes') without incorrectly accessing expected.get('rules'), which is the correct pattern for rule-type evaluators.

Complete coverage of instruction requirements. Evaluator checks all three specified slides (1, 4, 5) and verifies font size is 32 points with appropriate tolerance (1.0pt) for minor rendering variations.
Partial credit logic is semantically correct (pptx_metrics.py:21-36). Each slide contributes 1/3 to final score, allowing proper assessment when only some slides are correctly formatted.
Postconfig properly saves file (Ctrl+S) before evaluation, ensuring getter reads the current state of the presentation.
